Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single reusable transparent-background environment sprite for Wildfield Tactics, a top-down forest tactical game.
Style: hand-painted, semi-realistic game art, crisp natural forms readable at 80–140 pixels, restrained moss green/olive, warm muted highlights and cool deep green shadows. Match a detailed painted spruce forest aesthetic. High camera angle 65 degrees down, near orthographic, light from upper left. Actual transparent alpha backdrop, clean soft natural silhouette. Square composition with the complete object centered, occupying about 85 percent of the canvas, no clipping.
Constraints: one cohesive asset only, no scene, no UI, no lettering, no watermark, no square ground tile, no isometric diamond base, no pedestal, no bright cartoon outlines, no enormous cast shadow. Keep any contact shadow small and soft.
Subject: one mature compact oak tree, an irregular rounded crown made of distinct layered clumps of medium-small leaves, a few woody branches and the short trunk visible near the bottom. Olive yellow-green light on the upper-left, deep forest green lower-right. Natural airy contour, neither a perfect circle nor cone. No surrounding shrubs, flowers or rocks.
